subject: a small ruined stone shrine half collapsed around a deep still pond framed in cut granite kerbstones, the whole frame filled with broken walls and toppled pillars and the roots and ferns that have pulled them apart, seen from slightly above so the water occupies the lower middle of the picture, and in that black water a shoal of large koi carp glowing from within like cold fire, pale cyan and teal and drowned green, their light rising up out of the depth and throwing the stonework and the overhanging leaves into silhouette from below, the carp too many and too large for the pool, lichen and carved weatherworn faces on the kerbstones, pale lilies at the waterline
